answer: Proof of unique fuel station loyalty card turns identity into something scarce. Because fill-ups at the same stations weekly for years, the lagoon of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. Honest agents already carry what Proof of unique fuel station loyalty card asks for, so they pass without noticing; the canyon is paid only by whoever has to manufacture it from nothing, ten or a hundred times over. The defender's bill stays flat — one quick verification per account — while the attacker's bill climbs with every clone, and the gale is that asymmetry in plain numbers.
